items.why: Chip stocks led the selloff after a hot inflation report pushed yields higher. Reuters noted Nasdaq falling as chipmakers drop.
Volatility jumped as stocks slid after the hot CPI print put another Fed rate hike back in play, per CNBC.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as tech shares sold off on the hot inflation data.
Semiconductor names fell across the board with the market, after hotter inflation revived rate hike fears, per Reuters and 24/7 Wall St.

market_note: Futures pointed lower all morning; S&P and Nasdaq futures both down as yields rose.
summary: Stocks sold off midday as a hot inflation report pushed yields up and put another Fed rate hike back on the table. Chip stocks led the decline while volatility jumped.
